questions.stem:
Practice form 3.
A container starts with 4 liters and fills at 5 liters per minute. Which model gives volume V after t minutes?
A) V=4t+5
B) V=9/t
C) V=4+5t
D) V=45t
questions.explanation: Initial value plus rate times time gives a linear model.
